reasoning_docs.name: Codex config-reference docs (reasoning-effort)
reasoning_docs.purpose: Authoritative source for Codex reasoning-effort vocabulary (model_reasoning_effort and the plan-mode / summary / verbosity knobs) inside the `## config.toml` ConfigTable. Only the in-scope reasoning/verbosity config-key span is tracked; the source-hash gate hashes ONLY that span (via extract_codex_reasoning.isolate_in_scope) so unrelated config-key edits (providers, hooks, telemetry, catalogs) don't trigger a run. developers.openai.com serves raw Markdown at any page's `.md` suffix. The committed snapshot is update/codex-reasoning.json; the offline conformance gate is update/validate_effort_conformance.py (check D).

models_docs.name: Codex models docs (lineup, flag-only)
models_docs.purpose: The Codex recommended-model lineup, read ONLY to FLAG a model this tracker has not seen (open a deduped tracking issue). This cron NEVER edits selector model lists — new models are the Cursor catalog cron's lane. Parsed by update/extract_codex_models.py from the `slug="..."` attributes under `## Recommended models`.
